biography:
As VP of Energy & Sustainability, Ross leads Yondr’s sustainability agenda and renewable energy initiatives globally. Ross has spearheaded the development and launch of Yondr’s sustainability and Net Zero strategy. 

Previously, Ross was part of the leadership team in Naturgy Ireland, part of Naturgy Energy Group SA., a Spanish multinational energy company. 

He has over 15 years of experience in the energy and renewables space and has led teams that originated, negotiated, and signed hundreds of megawatts of Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs). Ross also has extensive experience in delivering innovative renewable energy solutions for large energy users.

At Yondr, Ross leads a team that oversees the implementation of the energy and sustainability strategy, ensuring that Yondr offers sustainable solutions to its clients and enables the business to positively impact the communities in which it operates.

Ross holds a manufacturing engineering degree and an MBA from Dublin City University.
